summary: Pulse Biosciences filed a Form 8-K on September 15, 2026 announcing completion of 100-patient enrollment in its PRECISE-BTN clinical study of the nPulse Vybrance Percutaneous Electrode System for symptomatic benign thyroid nodules, plus the first patient's 12-month follow-up completion at Sarasota Memorial. Enrollment spanned three U.S. sites within roughly twelve months after protocol expansion from 50 to 100 patients. This is a routine product-development disclosure under Items 8.01 and 9.01, not a special situation. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor named. Risk-arb angle: none; watch regulatory and clinical trial readouts.
